title: Africa coverage evidence tranche 1F - Madagascar, Malawi, Mozambique

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Republic of Madagascar operates the evisamada-mg.com platform as the official eService of Tourism, Immigration and Emigration for online visa applications.
The Malawi Immigration Department operates the official Malawi e-Visa application portal at evisa.gov.mw.
The Mozambique National Immigration Service operates the official e-Visa portal at evisa.gov.mz.

batch.name: v10.22.10 Africa evidence tranche 1F - MG, MW, MZ
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Madagascar (MG), Malawi (MW), and Mozambique (MZ). Madagascar's official e-visa platform is the eService of Tourism, Immigration and Emigration at evisamada-mg.com. Malawi's official e-Visa portal is operated by the Malawi Immigration Department. Mozambique's official e-Visa portal is operated by the National Immigration Service. All three endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable immigration/visa content. Gabon (GA), Gambia (GM), Guinea-Bissau (GW), and Democratic Republic of the Congo (CD) remain blocked or deferred from earlier tranches. Every proposal requires independent human review.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Madagascar e-Visa - official eService of Tourism, Immigration and Emigration
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Republic of Madagascar operates the evisamada-mg.com platform as the official eService of Tourism, Immigration and Emigration for online visa applications. This supports a proposal that Madagascar directly administers the relevant immigration rules.
